issues.problem: Teardrop pin is rotated in the reference (tip pointing up-left, body centred ~94,448) but upright in the build (tip straight up, centred ~92,447). Shape orientation is visibly wrong and it sits ~2px left.
issues.fix: Apply the Figma rotation to the pin (approx transform: rotate(-30deg) to rotate(-45deg), check the node) and shift left +2px so its centre lands at x=94,y=448.

issues.problem: Selected-year label '2019' is ~11px too far right: reference text spans about x=1329-1363, build about x=1340-1374.
issues.fix: Move the label left 11px; the gap between the label and the arrow group should be ~22px, not ~18px, with the arrow group starting at x~1380.

issues.problem: Prev/next arrows are smaller and packed tighter: reference arrows are ~12px wide at x~1386 and x~1409 (23px pitch); build arrows are ~8px wide at x~1395 and x~1411 (16px pitch).
issues.fix: Increase arrow glyph/icon size to ~12-13px (font-size ~14px or 12px svg) and set gap to ~10px so centres are at 1386 and 1409; keep right edge at x~1416.

issues.problem: Reference card has a clearly visible dark olive-green ~1.5-2px border and spans y=94-155; in the build the border is fainter/thinner and the card ends at y~154.
issues.fix: Set border to 2px solid dark green (approx #2f3d12 / the Figma stroke) and make card height 61-62px (reference) instead of ~60px.

issues.problem: Everything below the first card is 1px high: Central Africa title y=185 vs 184, Indian Ocean 255 vs 254, Add place / Share row 326 vs 325 (row bottom 348 vs 346-347). Cards are ~1px short.
issues.fix: Add 1px to each card height (or to the Amazon card only) so the stack matches: card tops at 94, 164, 234, button row 304-348.

issues.problem: Card is 1px narrower (right edge 353 vs 354) and second line sits 1px high (y=505 vs 506); title text is ~1px narrower, suggesting slightly tighter letter-spacing or weight.
issues.fix: Increase line-gap/padding by 1px between title and subtitle; check letter-spacing on the title matches Figma (likely 0 rather than a negative value).

issues.problem: Minus button, track and knob are all 1px left of the reference (button centre 571 vs 572, track start 593 vs 594, knob 824 vs 825).
issues.fix: Shift the volume row content right by 1px (padding-left +1px or left: +1px).

issues.problem: Search placeholder baseline is 1px high (y=47 vs 48); caption pill is 1px narrower (right edge 379 vs 380).
issues.fix: Nudge placeholder down 1px (line-height/padding-top); add 1px horizontal padding to the caption pill or match its text letter-spacing.

issues.problem: Diff shows fill differences on the faded future-year bars; the build's bars look marginally different in opacity/tint from the reference's translucent olive.
issues.fix: Verify bar fill and opacity against the Figma node (same green at ~40-45% opacity) and that no extra backdrop blur is applied.

notes: Very close build: every element is present, text content matches, and the map, route, player and mixtape panel line up to within about 1px. The clear misses are the Pacific pin orientation and the year picker header, where the 2019 label is ~11px right and the arrows are too small and tight. The rest is 1px drift in the right panel stack, hover card and volume row, plus a weaker border on the active card.
